_comment: Wall and floor surfaces offered by the inspector. Added in sprint S7, when the dat.GUI dropdowns became a thumbnail grid: the demo carried this list as a bare array of [url, stretch, scale] triples inside build/js/app.js with the names living separately in two dropdown maps, so a texture could be renamed in one place and not the other. Names, urls, stretch and scale are all the demo's; the thumbnails are the ones build/index2.html already referenced and nothing else did. Note that Checker and Bricks are the same image at different scales - odd names for brickwork, and the demo's own.
